_extra.biblia: The WHITE ARCHIVE is the key landmark: the biggest building, filling the top middle, all white stone with a great arched door in the middle of its south front. Every building is white or off-white stone; roofs are pale grey slate, white tiles or pale green copper (NO dark blue roofs). The wooden pier and the white ship moored beside it are in the sea at the bottom. A few loose white paper sheets lie scattered on the streets here and there, as if blown by the wind.
_extra.archive_1: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as blue-grey stone wall tops, not as rooms. The bookshelves are long straight rows exactly where the guide shows them.
_extra.archive_2: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as blue-grey stone wall tops, not as rooms. The copying desks are long straight rows exactly where the guide shows them, with a gap in the middle of each row.
_extra.archive_3: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as blue-grey stone wall tops, not as rooms. The corridor is a ring around a solid core; the eight small alcoves each hold one lectern.
_extra.archive_4: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as blue-grey stone wall tops, not as rooms. The four paintings hang on the north wall of the long corridor at the bottom.
_extra.archive_5: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as blue-grey stone wall tops, not as rooms. The staircase at the top is hidden under drifting layers of white paper.
_extra.archive_6: The hall is ROUND like a circle drawn with a compass: its wall is ONE smooth, perfectly curved ellipse of masonry with NO corners, NO straight segments and NO steps at all (never an octagon, never stepped or staircase-like, never blocky). The masonry blocks follow the curve. The short antechamber at the bottom joins the round wall with a simple opening. Many loose white pages lie scattered over the pale floor in a slow swirl around the middle. The altar dais at the top is round.

biblia: THE WHITE TOWN OF BIBLIA, THE TOWN OF THE RECORDS, ON AN ISLAND IN A CALM INNER SEA: a small harbour town where everything is white: white stone houses, white flagstone streets, a low white sea wall around the town. At the top middle the colossal WHITE ARCHIVE, a vast library of white marble with a dome, behind a low inner wall with an open gate; to its left the long Hall of the Records with a portico, to its right the great library with a pale green copper roof. In the middle a paved plaza with a round fountain and the white statue of a hooded girl storyteller holding an open book. Noa's inn on the left, the tavern on the right, a shop with a striped awning and small white houses in the south, a white stone quay along the sea with a wooden pier and a white two-masted ship moored beside it. Small lawns with white and pale blue flowers, a few slender pale trees. Palette: whites, ivory, pale greys, very pale blue-greys, soft greens, dark sea blue. Quiet, faded, as if the town were slowly turning into a blank page.
archive_1: THE GROUND FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, A VAST ANCIENT LIBRARY, seen from above with the roof removed: thick walls of cool blue-grey stone; polished ivory-white marble floors; a great reading hall filled with long rows of tall white-painted bookshelves whose books all have blank white spines; long wooden reading tables; a red carpet before a broad white marble staircase going up in the north; an entrance hall in the south with the great door; a small side alcove in the west and one in the east where a narrow stair goes down into white mist behind a low stone rail. Palette: ivory, white, cool blue-grey stone, pale gold, dark wood. Silent, vast, eerie.
archive_2: THE SECOND FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, THE COPYING ROOMS, seen from above with the roof removed: thick walls of cool blue-grey stone; ivory-white marble floors; three long copying rooms one above another joined by single doorways; in each room long rows of wooden copying desks with inkwells, quills and stacks of blank white paper; a white marble staircase going down in the south-west and one going up in the north-east. Palette: ivory, white, blue-grey stone, warm dark wood, black ink. Hushed, abandoned mid-work.
archive_3: THE THIRD FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, THE GALLERY OF MEMORIES, seen from above with the roof removed: thick walls of cool blue-grey stone; an ivory-white marble corridor running as a ring around a solid core; eight small alcoves opening off the outside of the ring, each with a small wooden lectern holding an open book in a faint glow; in the north a short hall before a tall sealed double door of white stone covered in pale glowing script, and behind it a staircase going up; a quiet resting place in the south of the ring and a staircase going down in the south-west. Palette: ivory, white, blue-grey stone, pale gold glow. Solemn, like a memorial.
archive_4: THE FOURTH FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, THE HALL OF LEGENDS, seen from above with the roof removed: thick walls of cool blue-grey stone; ivory-white marble floors; a long corridor across the south with four great framed paintings on its north wall; a west hall with white marble statues of robed figures on plinths; a grand hall in the north with round white pillars and a long red carpet leading to a staircase going up in the top middle; a staircase going down in the south-east. Palette: ivory, white, blue-grey stone, deep red, faded gold frames. Grand and haunted.
archive_5: THE FIFTH FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, THE WHITE SCRIPTORIUM, seen from above with the roof removed: thick walls of cool blue-grey stone; ivory-white marble floors; a small antechamber in the south with a staircase going down; a great copying hall with rows of tall white shelves on both sides and a long red carpet up the middle to the Grand Scribe's high writing desk of dark wood, with a tall candlestick and a huge open white book with blank pages; behind the desk a staircase going up, blocked by drifting layers of white paper. Palette: ivory, white, blue-grey stone, deep red, dark wood. Cold, still, heavy with sorrow.
archive_6: THE TOP FLOOR OF THE WHITE ARCHIVE, THE HALL OF THE VOID, seen from above with the roof removed: a great ROUND hall of pale ivory marble ringed by a smooth curved wall of cool blue-grey stone, loose white pages scattered over the floor in a slow swirl; in the north a round raised dais of three white steps with a white stone altar holding a huge ancient open book; a short antechamber in the south with a staircase going down. Palette: whites, ivory, pale silver, blue-grey stone, a touch of pale gold. Empty, dreamlike, blank.
